author: Deceitfulness
body:
Team that looks at the staff applications.
Umm, i just wanted to ask what exactly does "Your application has been tagged reviewing and will remain like this until at least 3 other Seniors read over your application and vote." mean?
I got 13 views, does that mean 4 of those guys are voting on my app or does it mean they have to write in the comments that they have decided to vote for me?
